title: The answer of bg3_events: the event log as one stream
description: Both sides' rows merged in the stream's order (docs/contracts/bridge-protocol.md, "One stream"), each with its side. `next` is the cursor to pass as `since` next time.

more.description: Present and true when `limit` cut the answer: ask again from `next`.

dropped.description: Where `since` is behind the oldest row kept: the rows between went (the store is bounded).

unplaced.description: Rows between `since` and `next` that no registry places (their `unplaced` says why), one entry per kind, whatever `kinds` and `family` asked for.

withheld.description: A fair server did not give these rows: a row it cannot place is taken as omniscient.

counts.description: Per family, both sides summed: rows and bytes written in the current boots, rows dropped.

on.description: The switchable families on now, on either side.
